bibliographic.title: The Bin Bag Theory
bibliographic.author: Katie Benson
bibliographic.description:
Beth is struggling with climate anxiety and brimming over with good intentions. Guide her through the pleasures and pitfalls of meeting new people, choosing which opportunities to embrace, and discovering the perfect way for her to make a difference.

Originally created for the Green Stories 2020 interactive fiction contest.
